abelian-group

Declared in structure-library/abelian-group.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (4): carr carrier; opr operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; iden constant in carr; inv operation carr -> carr.

Default arrows (is-hom-abelian-group-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-abelian-group(a, b, f) iff is-abelian-group(a) and is-abelian-group(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure abelian-group
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (constant iden carr)
  (op inv carr carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr)
  (property is-identity opr iden carr)
  (property has-inverses opr iden inv carr)
  (property is-commutative opr carr))

bundle

Declared in structure-library/strand-spaces.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (3): bspace substructure, a strand-space; bnodes carrier; bsend relation on bnodes.

Default arrows (is-hom-bundle-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-bundle(a, b, f) iff is-bundle(a) and is-bundle(b) and f in fun(bnodes(a), bnodes(b)) and bspace(a) = bspace(b) and forall([x1_ in bnodes(a), x2_ in bnodes(a)], [x1_, x2_] in bsend(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in bsend(b)))

Declaration.

(declare-structure bundle
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure bspace strand-space)
  (carriers bnodes)
  (relation bsend bnodes)
  (law (forall ssx_ (implies (in ssx_ (bnodes s)) (in ssx_ (nodes (bspace s))))))
  (law (in (card (bnodes s)) nn))
  (law (forall ssx_ (forall ssy_ (implies (in (list ssx_ ssy_) (bsend s)) (sends-to (bspace s) ssx_ ssy_)))))
  (law (forall ssy_ (implies (in ssy_ (bnodes s)) (implies (is-received (bspace s) ssy_) (forsome ssx_ (and (in (list ssx_ ssy_) (bsend s)) (forall ssz_ (implies (in (list ssz_ ssy_) (bsend s)) (= ssz_ ssx_)))))))))
  (law (forall ssy_ (implies (in ssy_ (bnodes s)) (forall ssx_ (implies (same-strand-before (bspace s) ssx_ ssy_) (in ssx_ (bnodes s)))))))
  (law (forall ssx_ (not (in (list ssx_ ssx_) (prec-strict (bspace s) (bnodes s) (bsend s)))))))

Defining predicate (as stored):

  • is-bundle — forall([s], is-bundle(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-strand-space(bspace(s)) and bnodes(s) in set and bsend(s) in power(cartesian(bnodes(s), bnodes(s))) and forall([ssx_ in bnodes(s)], ssx_ in nodes(bspace(s))) and card(bnodes(s)) in nn and forall([ssx_, ssy_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(s) implies sends-to(bspace(s), ssx_, ssy_)) and forall([ssy_ in bnodes(s)], is-received(bspace(s), ssy_) implies forsome([ssx_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(s) and forall([ssz_], [ssz_, ssy_] in bsend(s) implies ssz_ = ssx_))) and forall([ssy_ in bnodes(s), ssx_], same-strand-before(bspace(s), ssx_, ssy_) implies ssx_ in bnodes(s)) and forall([ssx_], not([ssx_, ssx_] in prec-strict(bspace(s), bnodes(s), bsend(s)))))

Theorems quantifying over is-bundle.

  • bundle-acyclic — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies forall([ssx_], not([ssx_, ssx_] in prec-strict(bspace(c), bnodes(c), bsend(c)))))
  • bundle-finite — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies card(bnodes(c)) in nn)
  • bundle-nodes-in-space — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies forall([ssx_ in bnodes(c)], ssx_ in nodes(bspace(c))))
  • bundle-nodes-set — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies bnodes(c) in set)
  • bundle-received-sender — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies forall([ssy_ in bnodes(c)], is-received(bspace(c), ssy_) implies forsome([ssx_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(c) and forall([ssz_], [ssz_, ssy_] in bsend(c) implies ssz_ = ssx_))))
  • bundle-send-sends — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies forall([ssx_, ssy_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(c) implies sends-to(bspace(c), ssx_, ssy_)))
  • bundle-send-typing — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies bsend(c) in power(cartesian(bnodes(c), bnodes(c))))
  • bundle-space — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies is-strand-space(bspace(c)))
  • bundle-ssb-closed — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies forall([ssy_ in bnodes(c), ssx_], same-strand-before(bspace(c), ssx_, ssy_) implies ssx_ in bnodes(c)))
  • precedes-partial-order — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies is-partial-order(bnodes(c), precedes(c)))
  • precedes-set — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies precedes(c) in set)

c-metric-space

Declared in structure-library/c-metric-space.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (2): pts carrier; dists operation nn -> fun(cartesian(pts, pts), rr).

Default arrows (is-hom-c-metric-space-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-c-metric-space(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in nn], (dists(a))(x1_) = (dists(b))(x1_)))

Declaration.

(declare-structure c-metric-space
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers pts)
  (op dists nn (fun (cartesian pts pts) rr))
  (law "forall([k_ in nn], is-pseudometric(dists(s)(k_), pts(s)))")
  (law "forall([u in pts(s), v in pts(s)],
          forall([k_ in nn], dists(s)(k_)(u, v) = 0) implies u = v)"))

Defining predicate (as stored):

  • is-c-metric-space — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dists(s) in fun(nn, fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rr)) and forall([k_ in nn], is-pseudometric((dists(s))(k_), pts(s))) and forall([u in pts(s), v in pts(s)], forall([k_ in nn], ((dists(s))(k_))(u, v) = 0) implies u = v))

  • c-metric-canonical-carrier-rev — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies pts(s) == pts(c-metric(s)))

  • c-metric-dist-converges — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([u_, v_], u_ in pts(s) implies v_ in pts(s) implies series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(k, nn, w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(u_, v_))), (dist(c-metric-w(s, w)))(u_, v_)))))
  • c-metric-dist-real — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies forall([k_ in nn, u_ in pts(s), v_ in pts(s)], ((dists(s))(k_))(u_, v_) in rr))
  • c-metric-is-metric-space — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(c-metric(s)))
  • c-metric-pseudometric-at — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies forall([k_ in nn], is-pseudometric((dists(s))(k_), pts(s))))

comm-monoid

Declared in structure-library/monoid.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (3): carr carrier; opr operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; iden constant in carr.

Default arrows (is-hom-comm-monoid-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-comm-monoid(a, b, f) iff is-comm-monoid(a) and is-comm-monoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b))

Declaration.

(declare-structure comm-monoid
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (constant iden carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr)
  (property is-identity opr iden carr)
  (property is-commutative opr carr))

commutative-ring

Declared in structure-library/commutative-ring.scm.

Kind. Refinement — declare-structure with (same-shape-as ring); its IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws> axiom is generated, not hand-written. Subtype of ring. Shape inherited from ring — slots (carr add mul neg zero one).

Declaration.

(declare-structure commutative-ring
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as ring)
  (law "forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], mul(s)(a, b) = mul(s)(b, a))"))

Default arrows (is-hom-complex-inner-product-space-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-complex-inner-product-space(a, b, f) iff is-complex-inner-product-space(a) and is-complex-inner-product-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], (ip(a))(x1_, x2_) = (ip(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure complex-inner-product-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op ip (cartesian vec vec) cc)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = cc")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s), z_ in vec(s)],
          ip(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_), z_) = ip(s)(x_, z_) + ip(s)(y_, z_))")
  (law "forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          ip(s)(act(s)(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * ip(s)(x_, y_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          ip(s)(y_, x_) = conjugate(ip(s)(x_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], ip(s)(x_, x_) in rr)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= ip(s)(x_, x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], (ip(s)(x_, x_) = 0) iff (x_ = vzero(s)))"))

Kind. Refinement — declare-structure with (same-shape-as integral-domain); its IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws> axiom is generated, not hand-written. Subtype of integral-domain. Shape inherited from integral-domain — slots (carr add mul neg zero one).

Declaration.

(declare-structure euclidean-ring
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as integral-domain)
  (law "forsome([dg in fun(carr(s), nn)],
          forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)],
            not(b = zero(s)) implies
              forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)],
                a = add(s)(mul(s)(q, b), r)
                and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b)))))"))

field

Declared in structure-library/field.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (8): carr carrier; add operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; mul operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; neg operation carr -> carr; zero constant in carr; one constant in carr; non-zero derived carrier, carved out of carr; mul-inv operation non-zero -> non-zero.

Default arrows (is-hom-field-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-field(a, b, f) iff is-field(a) and is-field(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((add(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (add(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((mul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (mul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((neg(a))(x1_)) = (neg(b))(f(x1_))) and f(zero(a)) = zero(b) and f(one(a)) = one(b) and forall([x1_ in non-zero(a)], f((mul-inv(a))(x1_)) = (mul-inv(b))(f(x1_))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure field
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers carr)
  (op add (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op mul (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op neg carr carr)
  (constant zero carr)
  (constant one carr)
  (derived non-zero carr (difference carr (singleton zero)))
  (op mul-inv non-zero non-zero)
  (property is-associative add carr)
  (property is-commutative add carr)
  (property is-identity add zero carr)
  (property has-inverses add zero neg carr)
  (property is-associative mul carr)
  (property is-commutative mul carr)
  (property is-identity mul one carr)
  (property is-distributive add mul carr)
  (law "not(zero(s) = one(s))")
  (law "forall([a_ in non-zero(s)], mul(s)(a_, mul-inv(s)(a_)) = one(s))"))

Kind. Refinement — declare-structure with (same-shape-as top-space); its IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws> axiom is generated, not hand-written. Subtype of top-space. Shape inherited from top-space — slots (pts opens).

(declare-structure metrizable-top-space

module

Declared in structure-library/module.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (6): scal substructure, a ring; vec carrier; vadd operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; vzero constant in vec; vneg operation vec -> vec; act operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec.

Default arrows (is-hom-module-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-module(a, b, f) iff is-module(a) and is-module(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure module
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)"))

normed-vector-space

Declared in structure-library/normed-vector-space.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (7): scal substructure, a ring; vec carrier; vadd operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; vzero constant in vec; vneg operation vec -> vec; act operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; vnrm operation vec -> rr.

Default arrows (is-hom-normed-vector-space-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-normed-vector-space(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure normed-vector-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op vnrm vec rr)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field)")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= vnrm(s)(x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s)(x_) = 0) iff (x_ = vzero(s)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          vnrm(s)(act(s)(r_, x_)) = abs(r_) * vnrm(s)(x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          vnrm(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_)) <= vnrm(s)(x_) + vnrm(s)(y_))"))

  • ring-multiplicative-monoid — into `monoid`: (carr mul one) ↦ (carr opr iden)

ringoid

Declared in structure-library/ringoid.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (7): carr carrier; add operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; mul operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; neg operation carr -> carr; zero constant in carr; one constant in carr; idl constant in power(carr).

Default arrows (is-hom-ringoid-def, replaced by declare-hom!): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-ringoid(a, b, f) iff is-ringoid(a) and is-ringoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and is-hom-ring(ringoid-as-ring(a), ringoid-as-ring(b), f) and forall([x_ in idl(a)], f(x_) in idl(b)))

Declaration.

(declare-structure ringoid
  (carriers carr)
  (op add (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op mul (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op neg carr carr)
  (constant zero carr)
  (constant one carr)
  (constant idl (power carr))
  (property is-associative add carr)
  (property is-commutative add carr)
  (property is-identity add zero carr)
  (property has-inverses add zero neg carr)
  (property is-associative mul carr)
  (property is-identity mul one carr)
  (property is-distributive add mul carr)
  (property is-ideal-in idl carr add mul neg zero))

Defining predicate (as stored):

  • is-ringoid — forall([s], is-ringoid(s) iff length(s) = 7 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and idl(s) in power(carr(s)) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and is-ideal-in(idl(s), carr(s), add(s), mul(s), neg(s), zero(s)))

(declare-structure semi-inner-product-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op rip (cartesian vec vec) rr)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field)")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = rr")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], rip(s)(x_, y_) = rip(s)(y_, x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s), z_ in vec(s)],
          rip(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_), z_) = rip(s)(x_, z_) + rip(s)(y_, z_))")
  (law "forall([a_ in rr, x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          rip(s)(act(s)(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * rip(s)(x_, y_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= rip(s)(x_, x_))"))

semigroup

Declared in structure-library/semigroup.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (2): carr carrier; opr operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr.

Default arrows (is-hom-semigroup-def): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-semigroup(a, b, f) iff is-semigroup(a) and is-semigroup(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure semigroup
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr))

Defining predicate (as stored):

  • is-semigroup — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) iff length(s) = 2 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)))

Theorems quantifying over is-semigroup.

  • hom-semigroup-id — forall([a], is-semigroup(a) implies is-hom-semigroup(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
  • semigroup-assoc — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))
  • semigroup-assoc-rev — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c)) = (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c)))

  • descend2-computes-rev — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), z)], respects2(s, f) implies forall([a, b], a in pts(s) implies b in pts(s) implies f(a, b) = (descend2(s, f))(class(s, a), class(s, b)))))
  • descend2-in-fun — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), z)], respects2(s, f) implies descend2(s, f) in fun(cartesian(quotient(s), quotient(s)), z)))
  • hom-setoid-id — forall([a], is-setoid(a) implies is-hom-setoid(a, a, id-fun(pts(a))))

  • rko2-refl — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a_ in pts(s)], related(s, a_, a_)))
  • rko2-sym — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a_, b_], a_ in pts(s) implies b_ in pts(s) implies related(s, a_, b_) implies related(s, b_, a_)))

strand-space

Declared in structure-library/strand-spaces.scm.

Kind. Shape structure — declare-structure with slot clauses.

Slots (5): tokens carrier; ids carrier; keys carrier; strand-map operation ids -> strands(tokens, keys); kinv operation keys -> keys.

Default arrows (is-hom-strand-space-def): forall([a, b, f1, f2, f3], is-hom-strand-space(a, b, f1, f2, f3) iff is-strand-space(a) and is-strand-space(b) and f1 in fun(tokens(a), tokens(b)) and f2 in fun(ids(a), ids(b)) and f3 in fun(keys(a), keys(b)) and forall([x1_ in ids(a)], (strand-map(a))(x1_) = (strand-map(b))(f2(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in keys(a)], f3((kinv(a))(x1_)) = (kinv(b))(f3(x1_))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure strand-space
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers tokens ids keys)
  (op strand-map ids (strands tokens keys))
  (op kinv keys keys)
  (law (is-token-set (tokens s)))
  (law (forall ssx_ (implies (in ssx_ (keys s)) (in ssx_ (tokens s)))))
  (law (forall ssx_ (implies (in ssx_ (keys s)) (= ((kinv s) ((kinv s) ssx_)) ssx_)))))

Defining predicate (as stored):

  • is-strand-space — forall([s], is-strand-space(s) iff length(s) = 5 and tokens(s) in set and ids(s) in set and keys(s) in set and strand-map(s) in fun(ids(s), strands(tokens(s), keys(s))) and kinv(s) in fun(keys(s), keys(s)) and is-token-set(tokens(s)) and forall([ssx_ in keys(s)], ssx_ in tokens(s)) and forall([ssx_ in keys(s)], (kinv(s))((kinv(s))(ssx_)) = ssx_))

Theorems quantifying over is-strand-space.

  • keys-in-tokens — forall([spa], is-strand-space(spa) implies forall([x in keys(spa)], x in tokens(spa)))
  • kinv-in-fun — forall([spa], is-strand-space(spa) implies kinv(spa) in fun(keys(spa), keys(spa)))
  • kinv-injective — forall([spa], is-strand-space(spa) implies forall([y, z], y in keys(spa) implies z in keys(spa) implies (kinv(spa))(y) = (kinv(spa))(z) implies y = z))
  • kinv-injective-rev — forall([spa], is-strand-space(spa) implies forall([y, z], y in keys(spa) implies z in keys(spa) implies (kinv(spa))(y) = (kinv(spa))(z) implies z = y))
  • kinv-involution — forall([spa], is-strand-space(spa) implies forall([y in keys(spa)], (kinv(spa))((kinv(spa))(y)) = y))
  • kinv-involution-rev — forall([spa], is-strand-space(spa) implies forall([y in keys(spa)], y = (kinv(spa))((kinv(spa))(y))))
  • strand-space-parts — forall([spa], is-strand-space(spa) implies is-token-set(tokens(spa)) and tokens(spa) in set and ids(spa) in set and keys(spa) in set and strand-map(spa) in fun(ids(spa), strands(tokens(spa), keys(spa))))

Declaration.

(declare-structure top-space
  (instance-var s)

  (law (in (pts s) (opens s)))
  (law (forall u (implies (in u (opens s)) (forall v (implies (in v (opens s)) (in (intersection u v) (opens s)))))))
  (law (forall fam (implies (subset fam (opens s)) (in (big-union u fam u) (opens s))))))

Defining predicate (as stored):

  • is-top-space — forall([s], is-top-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and opens(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and empty-set in opens(s) and pts(s) in opens(s) and forall([u in opens(s), v in opens(s)], intersection(u, v) in opens(s)) and forall([fam], fam subset opens(s) implies big-union(u, fam, u) in opens(s)))

Theorems quantifying over is-top-space.

  • bounded-metrizable-iff-gauge-countable — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies forsome([md], is-bounded-metric-space(md) and metric-top(md) == s) iff is-hausdorff(s) and is-gauge-countable(s))
  • bounded-metrizable-iff-gauge-countable-rev — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies is-hausdorff(s) and is-gauge-countable(s) iff forsome([md], is-bounded-metric-space(md) and metric-top(md) == s))
  • hom-top-space-id — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies is-hom-top-space(s, s, id-fun(pts(s))))
  • metrizable-iff-bounded-metrizable — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies is-metrizable-top-space(s) iff forsome([md], is-bounded-metric-space(md) and metric-top(md) == s))
  • metrizable-iff-bounded-metrizable-rev — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies forsome([md], is-bounded-metric-space(md) and metric-top(md) == s) iff is-metrizable-top-space(s))
  • metrizable-iff-gauge-countable — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies is-metrizable-top-space(s) iff is-hausdorff(s) and is-gauge-countable(s))
  • metrizable-iff-gauge-countable-rev — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies is-hausdorff(s) and is-gauge-countable(s) iff is-metrizable-top-space(s))

zz-ring

Declared in structure-library/numeric-instances.scm.

Kind. Instance — a constant tuple (an element of the class, not a predicate). Subtype of euclidean-ring.

Member of:

  • is-ring (via zz-is-ring)
  • is-commutative-ring (via zz-is-commutative-ring)
  • is-integral-domain (via zz-is-integral-domain)
  • is-euclidean-ring (via zz-is-euclidean-ring)

Components (mapped to inherited euclidean-ring slots):

  • carr = zz
  • add = vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ + y_)
  • mul = vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(zz, zz), x_ * y_)
  • neg = vnb-lambda(x_, zz, -x_)
  • zero = 0
  • one = 1

View-as declarations (alphabetical)

A view-as is a forgetful functor between structure categories, in exactly two cases: it forgets shape (keeps a sub-list of the source's slots) and/or forgets properties (the target's laws are fewer than the source's). The slot map below is written in the target's coordinates: position k shows which source accessor fills the target's k-th slot. Non-forgetful functors (quotient, completion) are constructions, not views.

  • abelian-group-as-monoid — `abelian-group` → `monoid`: (carr opr iden) ↦ (carr opr iden)
  • commutative-ring-additive-ag — `commutative-ring` → `abelian-group`: (carr add zero neg) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)
  • commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm — `commutative-ring` → `comm-monoid`: (carr mul one) ↦ (carr opr iden)
  • complex-inner-product-space-as-module — `complex-inner-product-space` → `module`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act)
